title: National Scholarship Portal — Central & State Schemes
description: One-stop official portal for multiple Central and State scholarship schemes for AY 2026-27. Complete One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar, then apply to eligible schemes. Always verify scheme-specific eligibility and deadlines on the portal.
eligibility_text: Indian students meeting scheme-specific criteria (merit-based and/or welfare-based). OTR via Aadhaar required on NSP.

title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College & University Students
description: Merit-based Central Sector Scheme for college and university students, administered through the National Scholarship Portal. Confirm current-year eligibility, income ceiling, and board rank criteria on NSP before applying.
eligibility_text: Indian students in college/university programmes who meet NSP merit and income criteria for CSSS. Verify exact cut-offs on scholarships.gov.in.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / NSP
description: Central/state-linked Post-Matric scholarship support for eligible Scheduled Caste students, applied via NSP. Check state-specific rules and income limits on the official portal.
eligibility_text: SC category students studying post-matric courses in India. Category certificate and income proof typically required.

title: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minority Students
description: Scholarship for students from notified minority communities pursuing technical/professional courses. Apply only through the official NSP and verify community and income criteria.
eligibility_text: Students from notified minority communities meeting merit and means criteria. Confirm on scholarships.gov.in.

title: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
description: DST INSPIRE-SHE supports talented students pursuing basic and natural sciences at the undergraduate and early postgraduate level. Apply only via the official INSPIRE online portal and verify current call dates there.
eligibility_text: Indian students in eligible science streams meeting INSPIRE performance criteria (board/entrance ranks as notified). Check online-inspire.gov.in for the open call.

title: INSPIRE Fellowship (PhD)
description: Research fellowship under INSPIRE for doctoral candidates in science and technology areas. Official applications and eligibility notices are published on the INSPIRE portal.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens enrolled/selected for PhD in eligible institutions meeting INSPIRE fellowship norms.

title: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
description: Competitive fellowship for PhD research at selected Indian institutions. Confirm lateral/direct entry routes, disciplines, and open cycles only on the official PMRF website.
eligibility_text: Candidates seeking PhD admission at PMRF granting institutions with strong academic credentials in STEM and related fields.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: AICTE scheme supporting girl students in AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma programmes. Apply through the official AICTE scholarship process / linked portals as notified.
eligibility_text: Girl students admitted to AICTE-approved technical courses meeting family income criteria published by AICTE.

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: AICTE scheme for specially-abled students in AICTE-approved technical programmes. Verify disability percentage and income norms on the official AICTE schemes page.
eligibility_text: Specially-abled students in AICTE-approved institutions meeting scheme criteria.

title: UGC Scholarships & Fellowships Hub
description: UGC publishes multiple scholarships and fellowships for postgraduate and doctoral scholars. Use the official UGC website to open the currently active scheme and apply only through notified channels.
eligibility_text: Varies by UGC scheme. Typically Indian students in UGC-recognized institutions.

title: CSIR Research Fellowships & Associateships
description: CSIR-HRDG administers JRF/SRF and related research fellowships. Eligibility usually depends on NET/GATE and institutional registration. Confirm open notifications on the official CSIR HRDG site.
eligibility_text: Candidates qualifying CSIR-UGC NET or equivalent and pursuing research in CSIR/eligible labs or universities.

title: Fulbright-Nehru Fellowships
description: Fulbright-Nehru programmes support Indian citizens for study, research, and teaching in the United States. Open calls, deadlines, and eligibility differ by award — apply only via usief.org.in.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens meeting USIEF academic and professional criteria for the specific Fulbright-Nehru award.

title: Chevening Scholarships (UK)
description: Fully funded UK master's scholarships for future leaders, including eligible Indian applicants. Use the official Chevening application system and country guidance.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens (and other eligible nationals) with leadership potential and undergraduate degree, meeting Chevening work-experience rules.

title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate & Postgraduate Scholarships
description: Reliance Foundation education programmes support meritorious students across India. Check the official Reliance Foundation education page for currently open undergraduate/postgraduate scholarship windows and eligibility.
eligibility_text: Indian students meeting academic merit and household income criteria published for the active Reliance Foundation scholarship cycle.

title: JN Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship
description: Loan scholarship for Indian nationals pursuing higher education abroad. Selection is merit-based; confirm application cycle and documents on the official endowment website.
eligibility_text: Indian nationals with a strong academic record seeking postgraduate study abroad.

title: Tata Trusts Individual Grants Programmes
description: Tata Trusts offer individual grant programmes that can include education support. Review the official Individual Grants Programmes page for open calls and application routes.
eligibility_text: Varies by grant programme. Indian applicants should follow the criteria listed on tatatrusts.org.

title: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation Scholarships
description: Scholarships for exceptional Indian students for postgraduate study and related opportunities. Apply only through the official Inlaks foundation website when the cycle is open.
eligibility_text: Indian passport holders with outstanding academic and extracurricular profiles, typically under foundation age/degree rules.

title: AICTE / MoE PG Scholarship (GATE/GPAT qualified)
description: Postgraduate scholarship support for GATE/GPAT qualified students in AICTE-approved programmes, as notified by AICTE/MoE. Confirm current notifications and disbursement rules on official AICTE channels.
eligibility_text: GATE/GPAT qualified students admitted to eligible full-time postgraduate programmes in AICTE-approved institutions.

title: Scholarships for Higher Education of ST Students (via NSP)
description: Scholarship support for eligible Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher education, applied through NSP. Verify scheme name, state rules, and deadlines on scholarships.gov.in.
eligibility_text: ST category students with valid certificates meeting income and course criteria.

title: British Council India — UK Study Opportunities
description: British Council India publishes guidance and links to UK study and scholarship opportunities for Indian students. Use this as a trusted discovery hub, then apply on each programme's official page.
eligibility_text: Varies by linked UK scholarship. Typically Indian students seeking UK higher education.
